title: ScanRequest
description: Mensaje publicado por el Gateway en el tópico SNS scan-requests (atributo routing_key scan.request) y consumido por ms-nmap. Shape copiado literalmente de nmap-service/src/domain.rs (ver `docs/decisions.md` (D-08)) — ssh_credentials_ref viaja como string plano con la credencial SSH real, nunca una referencia opaca (ver docs/security-scope.md).

correlation_id.description: Identificador de correlación de la solicitud de escaneo (newtype CorrelationId en ms-nmap, serde(transparent) sobre String).

scan_mode.description: How the target is scanned. 'ssh' (default when absent, so producers that predate this field stay valid): ms-nmap opens an SSH session on the target and needs network_user, ssh_credentials_ref and has_sudo. 'network': ms-nmap scans the target IP from its own container; the three SSH fields must NOT be present, so a credential never travels with a network scan.

ip.description: Dirección IP objetivo del escaneo, IPv4 o IPv6 (serde serializa IpAddr como string). Se valida con un patrón regex en vez de 'format: ipv4/ipv6' para no depender de que el validador de turno implemente esas format-assertions (algunos las tratan como meras anotaciones en 2020-12).

target_host.description: Network mode only. Hostname as typed by the user (RFC 1123: dot-separated labels of letters, digits and hyphen, 1..63 characters each, no leading or trailing hyphen per label, at most 253 characters in total). Used for display and as the HTTP virtual host only; the scanned address is always `ip`. The pattern also keeps a leading '-' out of nmap's argv.

extra_port.description: Network mode only. URL port to scan in addition to nmap's default ports.

ssh_credentials_ref.description: Credencial SSH REAL usada por ms-nmap para autenticarse en el objetivo (no una referencia opaca a un vault) — ver docs/security-scope.md. Nunca loggear este valor.
